parsed.change_summary: Added a loop to sanitize the buffer by replacing '%' and '\n' characters with spaces before printing.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because the buffer is now sanitized to replace '%' and '\n' characters with spaces. This prevents the injection of format specifiers or newline characters that could be used to inject malicious commands into the printf function.
parsed.behavior_changes: The behavior change is that any '%' or newline characters in the file contents will be replaced with spaces when printed. This ensures that the output is safe from command injection attacks.
